主要内容: Asta Funding, Inc. held its annual meeting of stockholders on March 11, 2014. The stockholders elected Gary Stern, Arthur Stern, Herman Badillo, David Slackman, Edward Celano, Harvey Leibowitz, and Louis A. Piccolo to serve on the board of directors for a one-year term. Voting results showed strong support for each candidate. Additionally, the stockholders approved a proposal to ratify the selection of WeiserMazars LLP as the company's independent auditor for the 2014 fiscal year. The voting results for this proposal were 9,893,011 shares for, 139,129 shares against, and 812 shares abstained. These actions reflect the company's governance structure and financial oversight processes.
